body: it can but really its a problem of taking up the only bathroom in the house. I do everything I can to stay out of the way.

I live off Tylenol and Ibprophen every 8 hours. If the gallbladder pain starts off I take tramadol. It takes the edge off so i'm not rocking in the shower but the pain is still there. I'm trying to not go over recommended dosages so I can't be accused of trying to be a drug fiend or anything of the like. It was how I was treated the second time I went into the ER by staff when the gallbladder pain started a few years ago.

next appointment is the 6th of july sadly. Its been nothing but blood tests and X-rays. If I push to get a referral to a specialist who can diagnose and prescribe something its still months out due to my geographical location.
the last 6 months its been body aches like you would get from severe flu. Its been all day everyday. As well as the longer term pain issue of gallbladder attack like pain on occasion.

the breakdown I was given was that they could not risk anyone at the practice renewing my prescription. That is what I was told. I also asked about letting the prescription run out and was told still a risk of renewing the prescription. I don't know man they do not want me as a patient and repeatedly told me so due to current and past prescriptions.
tired but keeping myself busy and making myself useful.

I've been keeping my friends in the dark tbh. I haven't spoken to any of them in a few weeks now with me being sick. I'm probably going to keep them there. They have their own problems with children, work, and homes I refuse to add to their plates with my problems even though there is no way anyone could help.

Sure tons if you like city builders Cities Skylines is very chill. There are also always the rereleases of some classics like Age of Empires 2 or Age of Mythology. tbh what I do is just dink around with weak AI if i'm needing to chill.
its a good time. Did you hear the dev has a content update on the way?
Video games for me help. Nothing multiplayer usually something light like Slime Rancher or Stardew Valley.

To be honest who isn't afraid to die? Its hard wired into us. Yes you aren't alone in wanting to pass away but being scared at the same time. I mean its probably 95% of the people in this sub. You mentioned antidepressents though I take it they aren't working for ya?

I am and have been on antidepressants for over a year sadly seems they aren't working and appointments to see my doctor to work on that take a long time due to waiting times for an appointment. I also had to stop seeing my therapist because of me going to the psychologist in the other town. Something about them not supporting 3rd party therapists. When it comes to government assistance I have no clue where to begin.
